# schedules

Scan schedules.

- Toolset name: `schedules`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 5 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_schedule`

**Create schedule** · mutating

Create a scan schedule from an iCalendar definition. Not idempotent: repeating the call creates duplicates.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `icalendar` | string | yes | iCalendar (RFC 5545) definition, e.g. a VEVENT with RRULE |
| `name` | string | yes | Schedule name |
| `timezone` | string | yes | IANA timezone, e.g. "UTC" or "Europe/Istanbul" |

### `openvas_delete_schedule`

**Delete schedule** · destructive

Delete a scan schedule (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a task still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_schedule`

**Get schedule** · read-only

Get one schedule by UUID, including its iCalendar definition.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_schedules`

**List schedules** · read-only

List scan schedules with their next run times.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_schedule`

**Update schedule** · destructive

Update a scan schedule. Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `icalendar` | string | no | Replacement iCalendar (RFC 5545) definition |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the schedule to update |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `timezone` | string | no | Replacement IANA timezone |
